en: Black‑and‑white postcard view taken through a stone archway, looking onto a historic brick building with an external staircase, ornate balustrade, shutters on the windows, and a crest on the wall. Bicycles are parked near the base of the stairs. At the bottom margin, white caption text identifies the scene as a view of the Waag building in Nijmegen. A small street sign is visible on the left wall.
